name: Judge Protocol
description: Deterministic evaluator for ERC-8183 agent-job escrow on Arc. Runs reproducible checkers (checksum, json-schema, contains, length, http) on provider deliverables, commits a recomputable evidence hash on-chain as the verdict reason, and settles escrow on Circle's canonical AgenticCommerce contract. Anyone can independently recompute a verdict from public inputs via the verify CLI or the in-browser verifier. Live on Arc testnet, day-one ready for Arc mainnet.
